# Maintainers can create a GitHub Work Item from a terse request and get…

<!-- axiom:work-item-draft:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa -->
<!-- axiom:provenance:Axiom:development:abc123def456:clean -->

**Work Item type:** `task`

## Problem

Generated Work Items are hard to scan.

## Desired outcome

Maintainers can create a GitHub Work Item from a terse request and get a concise, specific, readable Issue whose title stays on one line while every canonical section is preserved.

## Context

The GitHub renderer owns Issue presentation.

## Scope

Title and body presentation only.

## Constraints

Keep correlation markers machine-readable.

## Non-goals

No lifecycle or classification change.

## Acceptance expectations

Golden tests cover representative Issues.
